author: China Insights
description:
A set of private blueprints. Encrypted payments. An alleged international plot that stretched from Iraq to Europe and the United States.

According to investigators, a man linked to an Iran-backed militia network attempted to coordinate attacks targeting multiple locations — including a reported plan involving Ivanka Trump’s residence in Florida. But what he did not realize was that many of the people he contacted were already working with the FBI.

In this episode, we reconstruct how the operation unfolded: from online activity and encrypted communications to undercover agents, recorded calls, and the final arrest in Turkey. More than just a criminal case, this story reveals how modern intelligence operations now intersect with social media, cryptocurrency, and global networks.

#FBI #Investigation #TrueCrime #Espionage #IvankaTrump #Security #Analysis #CurrentEvents
title: The Plot Against Ivanka Trump: How an FBI Sting Operation Unraveled It
